text:
dan_arch: follow-up to CP-split RFC. proposing a 'locality boundary' per-region to own ephemeral egress leases and src-ip affinity. CP stays canonical.

priya_r: short sketch? how's this differ from relay/peering?

dan_arch: ascii:
```
global-cp
  +-- locality-us -> egress-pool-us (ENI/NAT or privatelink)
  +-- locality-eu -> egress-pool-eu
```
locality = thin operator: lease manager, short-lived certs, metrics. no model runtime.

jamal_s: security concern: boundary holding certs increases blast radius. rotation plan?

dan_arch: KMS-wrapped keys + CP-signed lease tokens with TTL (default 10m). renewals required; boundaries serve active leases until expiry if CP unreachable. nonce anti-replay included.

sara_ops: private-only tenants map egress-pool to private endpoints instead of NAT, so same surface. rollout: feature-flag per-tenant, start low-traffic region for 2w.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist generated: [boundary image], [lease-protocol], [metrics export], [private mapping], [cutover playbook].

priya_r: add security checklist (least-priv, KMS envelope separation, mTLS CP<->boundary, token nonce). jamal_s: add route-flap test during lease renewal. dan_arch: will update RFC appendix and push draft.
